name: Wild Eyes

angles.text: Forsaken soldiers contend with the bodily decay of undeath. They rely on the Royal Apothecary Society's grim concoctions to sustain their failing strength.
The Forsaken war effort in Silverpine Forest relies on Apothecary Renferrel's work at the Sepulcher. His research sustains frontline scouts and Deathstalkers.
Deathstalkers are the Forsaken's elite scouts and assassins. Restoring their strength is a priority in the region.

faq.answer: An ailing Forsaken Deathstalker in Silverpine Forest asks you to help restore their strength. With a second death looming and Renferrel's draughts failing, the scout gambles on different ingredients.
faq.q: Who asks you to gather murloc eyes?

faq.answer: The Deathstalker sees murlocs infesting Lake Lordamere's shores and proposes using their eyes. The scout hopes this new ingredient will draw Renferrel beyond his fixation on hearts.
faq.q: Why does the quest require murloc eyes?

faq.answer: Renferrel first scoffs and blames the potion's failure on too few hearts. Yet he admits he had not considered murloc anatomy and agrees to use it to restore the Deathstalker.
faq.q: How does Apothecary Renferrel react to the delivery?

aliases: where to turn in wild eyes
faq.answer: Apothecary Renferrel conducts his research at the Sepulcher, the main Forsaken outpost in Silverpine Forest.

aliases: why did renferrels potion not work
faq.answer: Renferrel says the potion failed because he received only three hearts, though the recipe calls for six. The ailing Deathstalker noticed no improvement from the formula.
faq.q: Why did Renferrel's original potion fail to work?

faq.answer: Renferrel is fixated on animal hearts in his restorative mixtures. That focus keeps him from considering other specimens until the Deathstalker brings murloc eyes.
faq.q: What is Apothecary Renferrel obsessed with?

sections.body: In Silverpine Forest, a Forsaken Deathstalker feels their body failing and faces a second death. Apothecary Renferrel's draughts have brought no relief. So the scout risks Renferrel's wrath and seeks another cure along the creature-ridden shores of Lake Lordamere.
sections.title: Desperate Measures

sections.body: The Deathstalker suspects Renferrel's focus on hearts has kept him from trying other reagents. So the scout asks you to gather murloc eyes and bring them to Renferrel at the Sepulcher. The strange organs broaden the apothecary's experiments, and he restores the fading scout.
sections.title: New Reagents at the Sepulcher

summary: In Silverpine Forest, Wild Eyes brings an ailing Forsaken scout to a desperate choice. Apothecary Renferrel's heart-based draughts have failed, and the scout seeks another way to stave off a second death.
